spans.s:
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Wishing to burn.
E.
दह to burn, desid. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (यन्-यन्त्री-यत्)
Desiring to burn.
E.
दह to burn, desid. v., शतृ aff.

f. (-धिः)
Firmness, stability, fixed state of mind or being.
E.
धा to have, affix कि, and the root reiterated.

(ङ्) दीधीङ्^1 r. 2nd cl. (दीधीते)
1 To shine.
2 To play or sport.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313. note: Also, affix Na change to N.

m. (-य्यः)
A pretended friend, an intimate.
E.
धा to have, Uṇādi affix आय्य, the root reduplicated, इट् and षुक augments.

m. (-षुः)
The second husband of a woman twice married.
f. (-षुः)
A virgin widow remarried.
E.
धा to have (sin), or धिष to be reproached, root reduplicate, affix कु or कू; in the first case, इट् and षुक augments; also दिधिषू.

f. (-षूः)
1 A virgin widow remarried: see the preceding; also दिधीषू.
2 An elder sister unmarried, whose junior is a bride.
m. (-षूः)
1 The husband of a woman married a second time: see दिधीषु.
2 Instability, want of firmness.
E.
दिधि firmness, षो to abandon, कू Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तिः)
The husband of a woman remarried.
E.
दिधिषू as above, and पति a husband.

f. (-तिः)
1 A ray of light, a sun or a moonbeam.
2 Light in general.
E.
दीधी to shine, affix क्तिच्.
